scope: Classic CANopen CiA 301 / examples; source anchors and assumptions

claims.claim: Upload reads from server and download writes to server, using client-server roles.
0x80 identifies SDO Abort and bytes 4–7 carry the little-endian abort code.
Segment upload uses 011t0000 requests and 000tnnnc replies, up to seven bytes per segment.
claims.notes: Toggle starts at zero; n is unused bytes

claims.claim: A 10-byte response can comprise a 7-byte segment followed by a 3-byte segment with command 0x19.
claims.locator: Segment response command bit layout, and reference/canopen_ch19_21.py

claims.claim: Block acknowledgement 0xA2 contains ackseq and following block size rather than bitmap.
claims.notes: Do not confuse with segment toggle

claims.claim: Object 0x2000:01 and returned 0x1234 are teaching-only data.
claims.notes: Not a claim about an actual vendor object dictionary
